نتفاءل (form VI)
# نَتَفَاءَلُ (natafāʔalu) /na.ta.faː.ʔa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَفَاءَلَ (tafāʔala)
# نَتَفَاءَلَ (natafāʔala) /na.ta.faː.ʔa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَفَاءَلَ (tafāʔala)
# نَتَفَاءَلْ (natafāʔal) /na.ta.faː.ʔal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَفَاءَلَ (tafāʔala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
